limitations: Posthoc validates saved rows, not execution of held-pidfd/runtime guards.
Old and new samplers cannot rule out unknown short-lived children entirely between snapshot points.
Release build not explicitly required by performance.md P-02; keep dev component result distinct from release/physical/8h budgets.
Reusing legacy rows requires explicit reviewer acceptance of observational evidence and other recorded host-noise limitations.
If reviewer requires every long window to have new guards, one replacement pair cannot satisfy that stronger scope; return exact gap, do not launch all twelve automatically.
